mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, cu.name AS customer_name, u.nickname AS owner_name, o.name AS opportunity_name, q.quote_no, so.order_no, COALESCE((SELECT GREATEST(0, LEAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN b.amount > 0 THEN b.settled_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0))) FROM fin_bill b JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = b.source_id AND b.source_type IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') WHERE b.kind = 'AR' AND c.order_id IS NOT NULL AND d.order_id = c.order_id), 0) AS received_amount FROM crm_contract c JOIN scm_customer cu ON cu.id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity o ON o.id = c.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN scm_quotation q ON q.id = c.quotation_id LEFT JOIN scm_order so ON so.id = c.order_id
